author_notes: Slot slot_165 targets a runnable Vue 3 + Vite agency marketing template (ryanbalieiro/vue-agency-landing-page-template, visible product identity 'Foxy'). The genre-native interactive feature is the Portfolio section's own category filter: the repo already ships an ArticleProjectGrid + FilterTabs widget that filters eight real project cards (SmartCash, Snappy, BrainPulse, LiveScore Pro, Stackers, MailM8, Sweet Scoops, RockVerse) across the Utilities / Productivity / Social focuses. The task upgrades that filter into a first-class 'Project focus' control with a live result-count readout and carries a compact focus recap from the portfolio through the featured banner into the contact/quote surface. Asset grounding is browser-visible through the fox agency logo, the header background image, and the eight local portfolio project logos rendered inside the filter grid via the existing Vite asset pipeline. A strong solution keeps the filter responsive (wrapping tab row + auto-fit card grid, no mobile overflow), keeps the active tab legible, re-derives the shown cards and the count on every tab click, and keeps the recap present across the portfolio, featured and contact surfaces. Design keywords: responsive project-focus filter, category tabs, result-count readout, portfolio grid, mobile layout, image thumbnails, cross-section recap.
design_constraints: Preserve the Foxy agency identity: dark navbar/contact section, orange primary accents, fox logo, project-grid rhythm, rounded buttons, Bootstrap/Vue spacing.

Build the Project focus control as the Portfolio section's own category filter (All / Utilities / Productivity / Social) over the eight real project cards; do not replace the page with a new landing page, dashboard, detached wizard, or external service.

The filter tab row and the card grid must be responsive: they must wrap/flex so the document never overflows horizontally on a 390px mobile viewport (tolerance 24px); desktop and tablet must also stay overflow-free.
The active focus tab must stay legible (sufficient text/background contrast) and the card grid must not overlap or clip cards.
Selecting a focus tab must re-derive BOTH the shown project cards and the visible result count ('Showing N of 8 projects the selected focus') from the current selection.

The compact 'Project focus' recap must appear across the portfolio, featured and contact surfaces so the focus theme carries into the quote; keep the project modal and contact form behavior unchanged.

change_completion: The Portfolio section shows a 'Project focus' filter with All / Utilities / Productivity / Social tabs over the eight real project cards (visible DOM text).
A visible result-count readout reads 'Showing all 8 projects' initially and updates to a filtered 'Showing N of 8 projects' with the focus name when a focus tab is selected.
The compact 'Project focus' recap is present across the portfolio, featured and contact surfaces.
design_consistency: The filter reuses the Foxy portfolio-grid rhythm, rounded tabs, and Bootstrap/Vue spacing rather than a bespoke off-system panel.
The active focus tab is legible and the project cards keep a consistent thumbnail-and-label treatment across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the document has no horizontal overflow beyond a 24px tolerance (the tab row wraps and the card grid re-flows instead of forcing a fixed-width strip).
regression: Portfolio project modal, FAQ, privacy and license routes, and the responsive navbar are unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured state.

metadata.design_goal: upgrade the portfolio's own category filter into a responsive Project focus control with a live result-count readout and a cross-section focus recap
metadata.source_repo_kind: Vue/Vite agency marketing template with a portfolio category filter, project modal, contact form, EmailJS integration, responsive navbar, FAQ, privacy route, and license route

problem_statement: The Foxy agency landing page (Vue 3 + Vite SPA) shows its work in a Portfolio section whose category filter can switch the visible project cards, but the filter gives no running feedback about how many projects match the chosen focus, and the focus theme is dropped everywhere else on the page. Upgrade the Portfolio section's own filter into a first-class 'Project focus' control: keep the All / Utilities / Productivity / Social tabs over the eight real project cards (SmartCash, Snappy, BrainPulse, LiveScore Pro, Stackers, MailM8, Sweet Scoops, RockVerse) and add a visible result-count readout that reads 'Showing all 8 projects' at rest and updates to a filtered 'Showing N of 8 projects' with the focus name whenever a focus tab is selected, with the shown cards re-filtered to match. Also carry a compact 'Project focus' recap across the portfolio, featured banner and contact/quote surfaces so the focus theme reaches the quote. The control must be a real DOM feature (visible tab and card text), must lay out responsively so the tab row wraps and the card grid re-flows without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport (tolerance 24px), must keep the active tab legible and the cards non-overlapping, and must re-derive both the grid and the count from the current selection. Shipped defects to avoid: a fixed-width non-wrapping tab strip that overflows mobile; a card grid whose cards shingle/overlap into an illegible pile or clip off the right edge; an active tab rendered as near-white text on a near-white chip; a count readout that stays frozen at 'Showing all 8 projects' after a tab is clicked; and a focus recap that never leaves the portfolio surface.
required_content: Upgrade the Portfolio section's own category filter into a 'Project focus' control with All / Utilities / Productivity / Social tabs over the eight real project cards (not a detached page or hidden label).

Show a visible result-count readout that reads 'Showing all 8 projects' at rest and updates to a filtered 'Showing N of 8 projects' with the focus name when a focus tab is selected, with the shown cards re-filtered to match.

Lay the tab row and card grid out responsively with no horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport (tolerance 24px); desktop and tablet must also stay overflow-free; keep the active tab legible and the cards non-overlapping.
Carry a compact 'Project focus' recap across the portfolio, featured banner and contact/quote surfaces.
Preserve the project modal, contact form, FAQ, privacy and license routes, and the responsive navbar unchanged.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the first viewport and confirm the page renders without horizontal overflow before any scroll or interaction.
desktop_portfolio and mobile_portfolio bring the Project focus filter into frame for the layout, visual-regression, and responsive-overflow checks over the tab row and card grid.
desktop_focus is the post-click state (Productivity tab) that must show the re-filtered grid and the updated 'Showing 2 of 8 projects' count readout.

desktop_featured and desktop_contact confirm the Project focus recap carries across the featured banner and the contact/quote surfaces; mobile_contact keeps mobile overflow coverage of the quote surface.
